title: The 10-Year Delay That Costs $400,130

beats.say: Starting to invest at 35 instead of 25 doesn't just lose you 10 years.
beats.visual: A vintage calendar on a dark wooden desk, shot from above, dimly lit by a single desk lamp.
A close-up of a hand sliding a metal calculator across a dark slate surface, blurred background.

beats.say: Here's the exact math behind the 10-year delay.
beats.visual: An empty coffee shop window at dawn, rain streaks on the glass reflecting amber streetlights.

beats.say: If you invest $200 a month starting at 25 and earn 8% a year until 65...
beats.visual: A stack of old silver coins sitting on a worn leather notebook, cinematic side lighting.
A sleek modern fountain pen resting on blank white paper, sharp focus, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: You only put in $96,000 of your own money.
beats.visual: A person counting plain paper currency with thumbs, shot from chest level, faceless.

beats.say: But if you wait until 35 to start the exact same plan...
beats.visual: A dark hallway with a single patch of bright sunlight cutting across hardwood floors.
A pocket watch lying face down on a rustic wooden table, dust motes floating in the air.

beats.say: That's $400,130 gone, just for waiting a single decade.
beats.visual: A solitary chair in an empty room, dramatic shadows stretching across the wall.

beats.say: Compound interest doesn't care about your excuses. It rewards time above all else.
beats.visual: Close-up of a mechanical clock's brass gears turning slowly in smooth, quiet motion.

beats.say: Stop waiting for the right moment to begin.
beats.visual: A person walking away down a long urban sidewalk at dusk, backlit by warm streetlamps.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: A minimalist dark background with a subtle pulsing light, clean and modern cinematic finish.

caption: Waiting 10 years to invest is the most expensive mistake you can make. The math doesn't lie. Follow for the money rules school never taught you. #money #personalfinance #investing #wealth #compounding
description: Discover the shocking cost of waiting 10 years to start investing. Using exact figures at an 8% return, we break down how starting at 25 versus 35 changes your final net worth by over $400,000.
first_comment: What age did you start investing, or what's holding you back right now?

facts.basis: Fact sheet: $200/month invested for 40 years at 8%/yr (monthly compounding) = $698,202
Fact sheet: $200/month invested for 30 years at 8%/yr (monthly compounding) = $298,072

facts.claim: Starting at 25 vs 35 with $200/month at 8% until 65 costs $400,130
